10.s: Assertion (A): Under a progressive tax, the average tax burden increases with income. Reason (R): Under a progressive tax, higher slabs of income are taxed at higher marginal rates.

Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
10.x: Both are true and R explains A: because each higher income slab is taxed at a higher marginal rate, the share of total income paid as tax (the average rate) rises as income grows.
10.tq: Recognise when R restates A.
n: A progressive tax has an average tax burden that increases with income. [Indian Economy · ROCKET SHEET #44 · pp 64-66]
